clue.text: Happy to admit copper's a metal

indicators.note: to admit something is to let it in, so one word takes the other inside it

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: Someone cheerfully owning up that copper counts as a metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Quicksilver is a liquid metallic element, so it is fairly called a metal.

clue.text: Finish mice off in local

indicators.note: off means gone bad or wrong, so the letters are muddled

explanation.surface: Getting rid of mice in a nearby place or a pub.
explanation.walkthrough: 'local' looks like a pub, the British word for one, but it is an adjective; 'off' turns MICE into EMIC.
explanation.definitionFit: Endemic means native or confined to a particular place, so local.

clue.text: Hurrah for food!

definitions.meaning: a shout of joy or approval
an old sense: food and drink, as in good fare

explanation.definitionFit: A cheer is a shout of hurrah, and cheer also means fare or provisions, as in festive cheer.

clue.text: Free to install policeman's alternative release mechanism

indicators.note: to install means to put in place, so the pieces go inside the other word

explanation.surface: A free option to fit a policeman's spare release device.
explanation.definitionFit: A ripcord is the cord pulled to open a parachute, a release mechanism.

clue.text: Price setter's suffering a blockage

parts.note: the setter's 'has' is I'VE, the setter speaking of themself

explanation.surface: Someone who fixes prices is in trouble with some sort of obstruction.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Setter's' is read as 'setter has', the crossword setter saying I'VE.
explanation.definitionFit: Costive is an old medical word for constipated, a bowel blockage.

clue.text: Line up books containing nothing in French

indicators.note: containing means holding inside, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, a set of books

explanation.surface: Arranging some books which contain no French.
explanation.definitionFit: To orient something is to align or position it, to line it up.

clue.text: Inspirational object securing stream

indicators.note: securing means holding fast, so one word contains the other

parts.note: a rill is a small stream

explanation.surface: An inspiring item with a brook held in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something thrilling excites and stirs you, much as an inspirational thing does.

clue.text: One from the away team gets it in the eye guard

indicators.note: in places the word within the eye guard

explanation.surface: A player from the opposing side is poked in the eye shield.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One from the away team' sounds like a player on a sports side; it simply means someone visiting.
explanation.definitionFit: The away side is the visiting team, so a member of it is a visitor.

clue.text: Feeling sick, drunken crew blamed pop

indicators.note: drunken means staggering about, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A drunk crew blame the fizzy drink for their nausea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunken' rearranges CREW BLAMED POP. Wamble-cropped is an old word for queasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Wamble-cropped is a dialect term for nauseous, with a churning stomach.

clue.text: Superstar said to be out of work

indicators.note: said signals that the word is spoken and we take the matching sound

explanation.surface: A celebrity is rumoured to be unemployed.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle can mean having no job or work to do, unemployed.

clue.text: Copying top lass reflected in refractor

indicators.note: in places the reflected pair within the other word
reflected means mirrored, so the two words read right to left

parts.note: gal is a word for a lass

explanation.surface: A top girl seen in a telescope's lens or prism, like an optics experiment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reflected' turns AIGAL into LAGIA, and 'in' puts it inside PRISM after the P.
explanation.definitionFit: Plagiarism is passing off someone else's work as your own, a form of copying.

clue.text: Rotating sphere nursing unknown compiler's future child

indicators.note: rotating turns the whole run round so it reads backwards
nursing means holding close, so one word contains the other

parts.note: the compiler (the setter) refers to themself as me

explanation.surface: A spinning globe holding a baby, the setter's future offspring.
explanation.walkthrough: ORB nursing Y gives OYRB; add ME and 'Rotating' turns OYRBME back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: An embryo is an unborn offspring in its earliest stage, a child of the future.

clue.text: Howl about Latin translation's lack of imagination

indicators.note: about means around, so the first word goes round the other

parts.note: to bay is to howl like a hound

indicators.note: translation turns the word into different form, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Complaining loudly that a version of a Latin text was dull.
explanation.walkthrough: 'translation' rearranges LATIN into NALIT, and BAY goes 'about' it, BA ... Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Banality is triteness or dullness, the quality of being unoriginal and unimaginative.

clue.text: Wartime hero of children's novel

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: taken letter for letter, including the S

explanation.surface: A war hero who appears in a story written for young readers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' rearranges all nine letters of CHILDREN'S. Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jews in the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: Oskar Schindler rescued Jewish workers from the Holocaust, making him a celebrated hero of the war.

clue.text: Original sin pressing on member of the opposition

indicators.note: original means novel or fresh, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Original sin weighs on a member of the opposing party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Original sin' reads as the theological phrase, but 'Original' is the anagram signal, making INS; 'on' just places the second piece after it.
explanation.definitionFit: An insurgent is a rebel who rises up against authority, one of the opposition.

clue.text: Diminutive creature getting hold of king's headgear

indicators.note: getting hold of means grabbing, so one word contains the other

parts.note: a mite is a tiny creature
R (rex) is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A tiny animal snatches the king's crown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting hold of' puts R inside MITE.
explanation.definitionFit: A mitre is the tall pointed hat worn by a bishop, a kind of headgear.

clue.text: Hoard what's left after holy martyrdom by fire?

definitions.meaning: a hidden store or secret supply

definitions.text: what's left after holy martyrdom by fire?
definitions.meaning: a saint burnt at the stake leaves behind only cinders: ST (saint) plus ASH

explanation.surface: Someone wondering what treasure remains after a saint is burnt.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is whimsical: split as ST ASH it is a saint's ashes; the question mark flags that.
explanation.definitionFit: A stash is a hidden supply put away for later, a hoard.

clue.text: Current providing insulation

definitions.meaning: a rising current of warm air
describing clothing that keeps heat in, such as warm underwear

explanation.definitionFit: A thermal is a rising air current, and thermal clothing is insulating.

clue.text: Support mineral's increase

parts.note: agate is a mineral, a banded form of quartz

explanation.surface: Backing a mineral company's expansion.
explanation.definitionFit: To propagate is to multiply or breed, making something increase in number.

clue.text: Rare animal entertaining golden girl with box

indicators.note: entertaining means hosting, so one word holds the other

parts.note: the panda is a rare, endangered animal

explanation.surface: An endangered animal hosts a golden girl who has a box.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Pandora opened the jar or box that loosed evils on the world.

clue.text: Tribune leader's right to help Old Labour

indicators.note: leader means first in line, so the first letter is taken

parts.note: to avail is to help or be of use

explanation.surface: A leader from the left-wing journal Tribune backs Old Labour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Old Labour' looks like the pre-1990s British Labour Party, but means labour in an archaic sense; Tribune is a left-wing British magazine.
explanation.definitionFit: Travail is an old-fashioned word for hard labour or toil, including childbirth.

clue.text: King introduced to marshal by name of god

indicators.note: introduced to means put into, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: R (rex) is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: A king is presented to a marshal by name of a god.
explanation.walkthrough: 'introduced to' puts R inside TITO, then N follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Triton was a Greek sea god, son of Poseidon.

clue.text: Sign of woe when summit's interrupted by otologist?

indicators.note: interrupted by means something breaks into the word, so it goes inside

parts.note: an otologist is an ear doctor, EAR DR

explanation.surface: Someone sad because a summit meeting was broken up by an ear specialist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interrupted by' puts EAR DR inside TOP after the T.
explanation.definitionFit: A teardrop is a single tear, the visible sign that someone is sad.

clue.text: Maker of cars, second in the month

indicators.note: in places the letter within the month's name

parts.note: Nisan is a month of the Jewish calendar

explanation.surface: A carmaker launching a model on the second day of the month.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts S inside NISAN, the first month of the Jewish religious year.
explanation.definitionFit: Nissan is a Japanese motor manufacturer that builds cars.

clue.text: Conductor beginning to talk during non-orchestral passages

indicators.note: during means in the course of, so the letter goes inside

parts.note: soli are solo passages, played by one performer

indicators.note: beginning means the first letter is taken

explanation.surface: A conductor starts chatting while the soloists play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning to' gives T, and 'during' puts it inside SOLI.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Georg Solti was a celebrated Hungarian-British orchestral conductor.

clue.text: Writer's boss takes to Cree dancing

indicators.note: takes means receives into itself, so one word contains the other

parts.note: an umbo is the boss in the centre of a shield

indicators.note: dancing jumbles the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: An author's employer takes up Native American dancing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Writer's boss' reads as an author's employer, but the 's is 'is' and the boss is the raised centre of a shield; 'dancing' yields ERTOEC to go inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Umberto Eco was an Italian novelist and essayist, author of The Name of the Rose.

clue.text: Burden boy's carrying round

indicators.note: carrying means holding, so one word contains the other

explanation.surface: A boy hauling something round.
explanation.definitionFit: A load is something carried, a weight or burden.

clue.text: Retired doctor adopting language as armour

indicators.note: adopting means taking in, so one word contains the other
retired means withdrawn, going back, so the word is turned round

parts.note: a GP is a general practitioner, a doctor

explanation.surface: A retired doctor takes up a language as protection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired doctor' suggests a pensioner, but 'Retired' turns the doctor round, giving PG to hold the language.
explanation.definitionFit: Plating is a protective covering of metal plates, a form of armour.

clue.text: Instrument in African music providing sustenance in Sicily

indicators.note: in places the instrument within the music

parts.note: rai is a style of popular music from Algeria
a viol is a stringed instrument

explanation.surface: A stringed instrument in an African band keeps someone fed in Sicily.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravioli are Italian stuffed pasta parcels, food you might eat in Sicily.
